notes.title: Major Update 0.199610
notes.notes:
Hi all

This is our second Major Update of the year! Can I ask all playtesters to start a new game, and play it as if you are coming to the game afresh, and attempt to complete the game as far as sector 3 where you encounter the new environments. Then feedback to me using f1 in game, and/or through discord. Thanks kindly!

This build has a bunch of new stuff I'm really excited to add, that really help flesh out the backbone of the game and set the stage for some interesting things to come. The most notable changes are a set of new farming outposts, and associated trash and elements, a stock market, with dynamic prices that fluctuate and are affected by your trading actions, plus three factory style product machines which you can use to make and sell products. We added the Holo-Map which you can use in space to get your bearings and find key locations such as entity bases and unidentified signals. We also have our first (of many) NPC quests, which we're testing in the first sector, and finally the Galactic Map, which you can access via your suit menu to plot your route through your designated salvage sector.

We also have some cool new sound effects, and some new visual effects in the form of ambient occlusion which round off the look of the game nicely, and a bunch of other balance, tweaks and fixes. We'll shortly be expanding products and items and tech you can build alongside other interesting things, so keep an eye out!

notes.title: Build 0.1991 - base structure update, QOL, balance and a new world seed!
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Welcome to Build 0.1991 patch notes! We've done a tonne of work to try improve base building.

You can now you can build 20+ new structural shapes, including a new roof system, new core shapes such as diagonals and spherical shapes, stairs, fences, new doors, a new floor system including wire and socket floors enabling multistorey base building with powered machines across multiple floors using a "power coupler", alongside a new placement system that allows you to rotate anything you build along z, y and z axis for more creative control, plus new decor items including rugs and succulents. Much more to come in terms of decor eg. lighting and more.

We need your input to tell us how this feels! Overall, you can just stick to how you made stuff before, or you can get much more creative. If you want to test building alone, feel free to use the cheat key to access the structures for free (ping me in discord).

Alongside that a bunch of other things, too numerous to say. Standouts include autopickup, and attack waves will only happen when you are home, and for fixed time frames. The death process is also improved so that you keep tools.

Finally, we have altered the core game loop a little, you no longer sell trash - you sell the cubits you extract from them OR you can build useful parts out of the cubits with factory machines, and sell them for more profit. Currently there is just one factory machine for microchips. We're reflecting on this change so let us know your ideas. It may stay, or we may change it.

The new world seed makes the first level different, so i'm also interested in the balance and ability to complete sector 1 which is now easier with balanced recipes.

notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

I've just posted a new update. I'll maybe post a changelog soon. 

In the meantime, if you get a chance, start a new game. Remember to file any bugs or feedbackl pressing f1 in game. If you are a new playtester, please fill out your first impressions form after 4 hrs play or so if you can (or when you stop playing if sooner!)

Thanks,

Al.
